clue.text: Fail to stand out during a demonstration

definitions.meaning: to stay seated indoors rather than standing outside
a protest where people occupy a place and refuse to move

explanation.surface: Someone at a protest fails to make themselves noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, staying seated inside is the opposite of standing outside; as one word it is an occupation-style protest.

clue.text: Stay and drink some beer

parts.note: to sup is to drink in sips
porter is a dark kind of beer

explanation.surface: An invitation to linger and have a few beers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stay' looks like a verb, but it is a noun: a stay is a prop or brace.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a prop that holds something up, just as a brace or prop does.

clue.text: Separate advice to the aspiring player

definitions.meaning: a verb: to dismantle into pieces
a would-be actor is told to accept a role

explanation.surface: Two kinds of counsel for a budding actor.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismantle something is to separate its pieces; an actor is told to accept a role.

clue.text: Standard number joining the Marines

parts.note: RM stands for the Royal Marines

explanation.surface: A regular recruit signing up with the Marines.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is the usual benchmark, the standard expected.

clue.text: Sporting gear proves an advantage to square couples

parts.note: a plus is a benefit or advantage
two couples squared make groups of four, as in a square dance set

explanation.surface: Kit that gives an edge to square-dancing pairs.
explanation.walkthrough: Plus fours are baggy trousers gathered below the knee, traditionally worn for golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Knickerbockers once worn by golfers are classic sporting clothing.

clue.text: Smarten up smart outfit to go to court

definitions.meaning: iron one's good clothes
pursue a lawsuit, or woo someone in old-fashioned courtship

explanation.surface: Getting one's best clothes ironed before appearing in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironing a garment smartens it; to urge a lawsuit or a marriage proposal is to pursue it.

clue.text: Fine bird of prey found in the hen-house

parts.note: F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
an owl is a hunting bird

explanation.surface: A good hunting bird turns up among the chickens.
explanation.definitionFit: Poultry such as chickens live in a hen-house.

clue.text: Agreement from a Mitford?

definitions.meaning: accord or harmony
One of the famous Mitford sisters

explanation.surface: Is harmony to be found among the famous Mitford sisters?
explanation.walkthrough: The Mitford sisters were six well-known British aristocratic siblings of the 1930s.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmony and accord are synonyms; one Mitford sister bore this first name.

clue.text: Material evidence Edward being embraced by Susan

indicators.note: the name for Edward is held inside the name for Susan

parts.note: Sue is short for Susan
Ed is short for Edward

explanation.surface: A piece of fabric proves Edward was hugged by Susan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Material evidence' reads as a legal phrase; only 'Material' defines, and 'evidence' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Suede is a soft leather used as a fabric, so it is a material.

clue.text: Game which may be placed under fire

definitions.meaning: a card game

definitions.text: which may be placed under fire
definitions.meaning: an iron rod stuck into a fire to stir the coals

explanation.surface: A game that might come under attack.
explanation.definitionFit: The card game shares its name with the fireside rod used to stir coals.

clue.text: Former Welsh rite to be reviewed

indicators.note: looking over again implies the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: An old Welsh ceremony is being looked at again.
explanation.definitionFit: Erstwhile means of an earlier time, synonymous with one-time.

clue.text: Tenant farmers who take their cut form the market

definitions.meaning: farmers who pay rent with part of the crop

definitions.text: who take their cut form the market
definitions.meaning: punningly, people who prune shares, taking a portion

explanation.surface: Tenant farmers take a commission on what they sell.
explanation.definitionFit: These tenants pay rent with a share of the crop they harvest.

clue.text: Stone work by a novice

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
L is a learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A gem cut by an apprentice.
explanation.definitionFit: Opal is a gemstone, so it is a stone.

clue.text: Belief which I rail against

parts.note: to slam is to criticise harshly

explanation.surface: Someone declares a faith they personally oppose.
explanation.definitionFit: Islam is a religion, a system of belief.

clue.text: How mines may be cleared from the cowshed

definitions.meaning: ..., the Royal Engineers, who clear mines
a shed where cattle are kept

explanation.surface: Minefield clearance happening near a farm building.
explanation.walkthrough: RE is the standard abbreviation for the Royal Engineers, the British army's sappers.
explanation.definitionFit: A byre is a farm building for cattle.

clue.text: Each marine signal was invented by him

annotationWithheld.why: Each marine signal was invented by him (5): Very invented the Very light, giving VERY; no clue word supplies the extra E of EVERY, so the clue looks garbled as held.
annotationWithheld.clue: Each marine signal was invented by him

clue.text: Call briefly when the old man's home

definitions.meaning: visit for a short time
father (pop) is in

explanation.surface: Drop by while Dad is in.
explanation.definitionFit: A short visit is a quick drop-by; Dad, called Pop, being at home is him being in.

clue.text: Warning contained in advertisement for loan

definitions.meaning: prior notification
a notice announcing a cash advance

explanation.surface: Fine print about borrowing contains a caution.
explanation.definitionFit: Warning given ahead of time is prior notification.

clue.text: Seriously resent Ian being replaced

indicators.note: the letters are put back in different places

explanation.surface: Someone truly resents being swapped for Ian.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in earnest means doing it sincerely.

clue.text: Its thirteenth position in the Periodic Table is basic

parts.note: each entry in the Periodic Table is an element
aluminium, symbol Al, is element number 13

explanation.surface: A chemistry fact about what sits at number thirteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Elemental means fundamental or primary.

clue.text: What the receiver must do as a quid pro quo

definitions.meaning: in tennis the receiving player must hit the serve back
a favour done in exchange

explanation.surface: A recipient owes something in exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennis receivers hit back the opponent's opening shot; a favour done in exchange repays one.

clue.text: Not a genuine mimic

definitions.meaning: fake, imitation
to imitate in ridicule

explanation.surface: A fake impersonator.
explanation.definitionFit: Fake means imitation; to mimic is to imitate mockingly.

clue.text: Most important figure in the Government

definitions.meaning: chief, principal
John ..., former British Prime Minister

explanation.surface: Who is the key player in the cabinet?
explanation.definitionFit: Chief or principal; also the surname of a 1990s British Prime Minister.

clue.text: Copper drill of eighteen inches or more

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a bit is the cutting part of a drill

explanation.surface: A copper drill bit of some length.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient unit of length based on the forearm, about eighteen inches or longer.

clue.text: Complaint received by quiet Police Sergeant

parts.note: keeping mum means staying silent

explanation.surface: A grievance taken by a silent officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Here complaint means an illness, such as a childhood infection.

clue.text: Dismiss from court when charge is dropped

definitions.meaning: release an accused person
no fee is charged

explanation.surface: Being released once the case is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Releasing a defendant sets them at liberty; something without a charge costs nothing.

clue.text: Some noise might filter through its walls

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Neighbours' noise may come through shared walls.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-detached house shares a party wall, so sound may pass through.

clue.text: Heated conflict supported by a large number

indicators.note: in a down clue the number sits under the conflict

parts.note: war is armed conflict
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A hot war propped up by many.
explanation.definitionFit: Heated means made hot, near in sense to warm.

clue.text: Employment office makes a patient man take heart

parts.note: Job is the biblical figure famous for patience
the centre is the heart of something

explanation.surface: A patient person seeks work at the employment office.
explanation.definitionFit: A government agency helping people find work is an employment office.

clue.text: He must be good at assimilating intelligence

definitions.text: He must be good at assimilating intelligence

parts.words: He must be good at assimilating intelligence
parts.note: intelligence here means secret information, gathered by a spy

explanation.surface: Someone who has to be a quick learner.
explanation.definitionFit: A spy gathers secret information, so absorbing intelligence is the job.

clue.text: People who keep servants

definitions.meaning: those who hold on to things
long-serving household staff

explanation.surface: Employers of household staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who hold on are keepers; household staff of a great family are servants.

clue.text: Medic allowed back into accommodation

parts.note: MO is a medical officer

indicators.note: the word for allowed is turned round

parts.note: let means permitted

explanation.surface: A doctor permitted to return to the lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside hotel offers lodging, so it provides accommodation.
